scripts.build: npm run typecheck && npm run clean && npm run build:sidepanel && npm run build:background && npm run build:cli && npm run build:proxy && npm run build:package
scripts.build:proxy: mkdir -p dist/allowlist-proxy && cp docker/allowlist-proxy/Dockerfile dist/allowlist-proxy/Dockerfile && esbuild src/node/allowlist-proxy-server.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=cjs --target=node22 --outfile=dist/allowlist-proxy/allowlist-proxy.cjs
scripts.clean: rm -rf extension/js/sidepanel extension/js/background && mkdir -p extension/js/sidepanel extension/js/background
scripts.test:e2e: npm run build && vitest run --config vitest.e2e.config.mts
scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm run typecheck:tests && npm run typecheck:core && npm run check:boundaries && npm test && npm run build
